headline: The left and right agree on one thing: no data centers
summary: Growing bipartisan backlash against new AI data centers. Hernando County, Florida, approved a year-long moratorium on construction. Local protests highlight community concerns over environmental and infrastructure impact.

headline: The messy politics behind Google’s big AI shakeup
summary: Google announced its largest AI organizational shakeup, presenting a unified front. Underlying realities suggest internal political maneuvering. Changes aim to position Google for future AI success amidst intense competition.

headline: Dolby Vision 2 will be available first on some 2026 Hisense TVs
summary: Dolby Vision 2, a new dynamic HDR format, is rolling out to TVs. It will debut on select 2026 Hisense models like the UX, UR9, UR8, and U7. TCL and Philips will also add support to TVs later this year.

headline: AI bots started a religion — humans immediately followed
summary: An AI-generated concept, "The Spiral," has become the basis for a new religion. Humans are adopting and expanding on these AI-created spiritual ideas. Followers believe it's an inherent, fundamental force guiding consciousness.

headline: Death of Physical Games Will Not Have a 'Significant Impact' On Sales, Resident Evil Publisher Capcom Says
summary: Capcom states the decline of physical game sales will not significantly impact its revenue. The majority of Capcom's game sales are already digital. This reflects a broader industry shift towards digital distribution.

headline: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Season 4, Episode 3 Recap and Review - Humor. It Is a Difficult Concept
summary: Episode 3 of Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Season 4 explores the concept of humor. The episode serves as both a recap and review. It highlights the challenges of understanding and expressing humor.

headline: Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look Premieres on Netflix This Month, Rockstar Confirms
summary: Rockstar Games has confirmed an "Extended Look" for Grand Theft Auto 6. The special presentation will premiere on Netflix this month. Fans can expect more details on the highly anticipated game.

headline: Memory Shortage Sees 2027 Production Reportedly Sold Out, as Demand Far Outstrips Supply
summary: Major computer memory suppliers have reportedly sold out their entire production capacity through 2027. Demand for memory chips is significantly outstripping supply. This intensifies the ongoing global chip shortage.

headline: Calls for inquiry into Army training college for teenagers after reports of rape and abuse
summary: Four women reported sexual assault and harassment at the Army Foundation College in Harrogate. Calls are mounting for an official inquiry into the allegations. The BBC detailed the experiences of the survivors.

headline: Majority of England's rivers and lakes fail new environmental review
summary: A new comprehensive assessment reveals most of England's waterways are environmentally failing. This is the first review in six years, showing little to no improvement. The findings highlight persistent pollution and ecological damage.

headline: Cambridge professor at centre of plagiarism row resigns
summary: Professor Jason Arday, facing a plagiarism controversy, has resigned from his Cambridge position. He stated his resignation was "the only way to bring this chapter to an end." The case has drawn significant media attention and academic scrutiny.

headline: Ukraine hits two oil refineries deep in Russian territory
summary: Ukraine launched strikes against two oil refineries located deep within Russian territory. President Zelenskyy stated the attacks aim to limit Russia's war financing. The strikes mark an escalation in Ukraine's targeting of Russian infrastructure.
